Companion Animal travel requirements at check-in

Travelers, review the crate rules now so your companion animal proceeds without delay.

The minimum travel age for a reptile is 11 weeks. Reptile travel starts when the animal is old enough to be shipped safely at 11 weeks.

For crate sizing, measure carefully and choose the correct container before you arrive. The cat must fit within the maximum crate dimension of 61 cm, meaning the longest side of the crate cannot exceed 61 cm.

Safety takes priority over speed in every journey on Aurelia Skyways. Please ensure the crate is secure, clean, and easy to handle, with ventilation openings that are not blocked. Place bedding so it does not shift during movement, and confirm the door latches properly. If you are traveling with Blue and coordinating with your own travel plans, have all documentation ready for inspection at the counter.

When you reach the airport, present your companion animal crate to the Companion Animal Travel Desk early, and follow the instructions of the staff member assisting you. Clear preparation reduces handling time and supports safer transport for all animals.

For verification of age and crate fit, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways at your departure location.
